description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Awoken Ballad], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Holy)] and [Memories of Home Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ballad
description.text: Summoning and Bard abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Summoning and Bard abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Summoning and Bard abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Memories of Home Mode
description.text: Casts Princess's Resolve after another ally uses two Summoning abilities, removed after triggering three times

description.name: Princess's Resolve
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)], grants [Summoning +30% Boost 1] to all allies

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]
